articles.title: Russia, Ukraine swap 193 POWs
articles.summary: Russia and Ukraine completed a significant prisoner exchange on Friday, swapping 193 captured soldiers each. This marks the second reciprocal exchange between the warring nations, following a previous swap facilitated by the UAE. Such exchanges are crucial humanitarian gestures amidst ongoing conflict, reflecting limited diplomatic channels for de-escalation and personnel recovery.

articles.title: India's smartphone production was on the rise in 2025, but strong headwinds await
articles.summary: India's smartphone manufacturing achieved 8% year-over-year growth in 2025, driven significantly by a 28% surge in exports, according to Counterpoint's "Make in India" tracker. This highlights India's increasing industrial strength and its emerging role as a major electronics manufacturing and export hub, boosting national economic progress.

articles.title: China Rolls Out Undersea Mineral Map
articles.summary: China has launched a new deep-sea seabed atlas, mapping critical minerals like cobalt and nickel across vast underwater regions. This "treasure map" provides strategic insights into vital resources crucial for future technologies and economic development. For SSB aspirants, this signifies China's assertive move in securing resource independence and highlights potential for increased global competition over deep-sea mining rights, impacting international relations and national strategic interests.

articles.title: In Defense of Indonesia’s Russia-America Balancing Act
articles.summary: Indonesia's new military partnership with the United States is under scrutiny, as some fear it might upset BRICS supporters. This situation underscores the distinct nature of economic and security alliances, highlighting Indonesia's strategic balancing act within a complex global geopolitical landscape and the differing perceptions of international groupings.
